summary: Reference-only: held book casts Charm Monster once per dawn (DC 15; non-Humanoids save with Disadvantage).
text: Reference-only: held book casts Charm Monster once per dawn (DC 15; non-Humanoids save with Disadvantage). Attunement grants Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion proficiency, changeable on a Long Rest. Carrying it, a successful Study/Arcana check on a visible Aberration, Construct, Elemental, Fey, or Monstrosity also reveals its damage defenses.
